issues.quote: Tesla grew revenue 32.6% in fiscal 2023 to $96.8 billion, up from $81.5 billion
issues.problem: Growth from $81.5B to $96.8B is about 18.8%, not 32.6%. The note's rounding check misses this.
Actual growth was about 19.2% ($15.00B vs $12.58B). Minor.

data.summary: The revenue growth rate is badly wrong (it should be about 18.8%). All other figures match Tesla's FY2023 results apart from small rounding differences. The rise in net income came from a one-time tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a deferred tax asset reserve.
